stories.why: Accenture says hackers exploited MiCollab flaws before Mitel’s advisory, likely aided by AI, in a suspected extortion campaign.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit N-able MailAssure Flaw While AI Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day
Hackers Compromise 24 Check Point Management Servers in Suspected AI-Driven Attack Campaign
stories.why: An unknown threat actor has been using artificial intelligence (AI)-driven offensive tooling in a campaign targeting Check Point Security Management servers, impacting 22 distinct organizations across the world.

stories.title: Chinese and North Korean state hackers add ARTEX AI framework to their arsenal
stories.why: State-sponsored hacking groups tied to Beijing and Pyongyang have started running the ARTEX pentesting tool in attacks, Microsoft Threat Intelligence warned this week.

stories.title: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators
stories.why: Attackers using AI agents have broken into computer systems at Swiss organizations in four of five confirmed attacks, the first such cases in the country, the country's cybersecurity agency said yesterday.
